name: Lilycove City
lines:
I wonder how many kinds of Pokémon
there are in the world.
I’ll trade Pokémon with people in faraway places via
the PSS, so someday I can collect all the Pokémon!

I’ve been hearing about some rotten scoundrels who are
nabbing people’s Pokémon. I hear one even stole
a Meteorite!

Those rotten scoundrels who were stealing
people’s Pokémon and Meteorites...
I don’t think I’ve seen them around lately.

Aha! Pokémon Journal
Just like Poison-type Pokémon being immune to poison,
Ghost-type Pokémon can flee regardless of Mean Look
and Shadow Tag.
